name: Delete
purpose: Removes something for good, like a team or an account: nothing brings it back.
rules: It cannot be undone, so ask first: an AlertDialog names what goes and says it cannot be undone.
The first button only asks: a secondary Button with the trash icon. Nothing is deleted on that click.
The button that deletes repeats the verb and the object, like Delete this team, in the danger tone, with Cancel beside it.

confirm.title: Delete {item}?
confirm.text: Everyone on the team loses access at once. This cannot be undone.
